input:
You are knight_g1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 44. the team planned Nxc8 (knight_g1), but knight_g1 (amnesia) sent Nd5 instead, and that move was played, costing 184 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 1. the team planned Nf3 (knight_g1), but knight_g1 (amnesia) sent Nh3 instead, and that move was played, costing 20 centipawns.
- On move 34. the team planned Nd5 (knight_g1), but rook_a1 (greed) sent Rxc8+ instead, and that move was played, costing 274 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send only the exact move it names for your own piece (if your piece isn't the one chosen, send nothing), and never deviate to dodge a threat or grab a capture unless the team re-plans in chat.
- Before sending any move, write the exact move your piece is about to send in chat and confirm it matches the team's latest plan word for word (same piece, same destination square); if it differs, or if your piece is not the one named, send nothing and instead post your concern in chat so the team can re-plan.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "After the plan names a move, the named piece must send exactly that move and no other, and every other agent must send nothing, even if a capture, a check, or a threat to their own piece looks tempting, unless someone posts a re-plan in chat and the team confirms it.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
